definition: Look through the plugin directory or a marketplace catalog to see which plugins exist and what they contain.
outcome: the reader has seen which plugins are listed and what each one bundles; nothing is installed and no marketplace is registered

records.outcome: the user has seen which organization plugins are already installed and which ones administrators have made available; nothing is installed by these steps
preconditions: administrators have added plugins for the organization
steps: Review installed plugins under Organization plugins
Open the Organization tab to see every plugin administrators made available

evidence.quote: select **Browse plugins** and open the **Organization** tab, which lists every plugin your administrators have made available to you.

records.notes: Claude for Government has no public plugin marketplace; the Organization tab is the catalog.

records.outcome: the reader has seen the full collection of open-sourced plugins and what each one does; nothing is installed and no marketplace is registered
records.notes: Single-action pointer to the directory site; the accompanying table of 11 open-sourced plugins is a concept table, not part of the steps.
